title: If You Know These 5 Words, Your English Is Advanced (Part 4) #shorts
description:
If you know these 5 words, your English is advanced:
• Obsolete: no longer used
• Versatile: good at many different things
• Profound: very deep or serious
• Trivial: small and unimportant
• Spontaneous: done without planning

How many did you know? Write your score in the comments.
